SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand, sum(ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg 
FROM date_dim dt 
JOIN store_sales ss ON dt.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk 
JOIN (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand 
    FROM item 
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
) AS filtered_item ON ss.ss_item_sk = filtered_item.i_item_sk 
WHERE dt.d_moy = 11 
GROUP BY dt.d_year, filtered_item.i_brand_id, filtered_item.i_brand 
ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC, filtered_item.i_brand_id 
LIMIT 100
